findings.claim: FY2025 十大客戶占鐵礦砂及球團銷量 36.3%、營收 35.8%；中國占出貨 63%；2025 與 2024 無單一客戶占營收 10% 以上（2023 有一家占 10%）。
findings.excerpt: Our ten largest customers collectively purchased 114.0 million metric tons of iron ore and iron ore pellets from us, representing 36.3% of our 2025 iron ore and iron ore pellet sales volumes and 35.8% of our total iron ore and iron ore pellet revenues. In 2025 and 2024, no customer individually represented 10% or more of our revenue.

findings.claim: 鎳業務客戶全球分散，2025、2024、2023 皆無單一客戶占淨營收 10% 以上。
findings.excerpt: No customer individually represented 10% or more of our net operating revenue in 2025, 2024 and 2023.

note: 客戶自身信用惡化：一次搜尋未找到 2026 年中國鋼廠信用壓力與 Vale 應收或客戶違約的直接來源；搜尋出現的 Moody's 降級俄文標題日期不明且未核實，不採用。
